messages.subject: No D-RUG this week. Post your questions on our Discourse!
parts:
We will not be having D-RUG this week but DataLab will still be open for socializing etc during Tea Time (1-2pm) and Co-working (2-4pm). Given that, this is a great time to acquaint yourself with our Discourse forum, where you can ask all your R questions asynchronously.

Tea Time: 1-2pm, DataLab Classroom, Library 360
Co-working: 2-4pm, DataLab Classroom Room, Library 360

Have a good week,

Your D-RUG Coo[R]dinators
